title: Freedom Demands Mental Transformation
text: [Music] you can be set free from the whip but not free from the control i think about our third world countries some of us have been independent for 20 30 years and we still colonialized why because independence doesn't set you free independence gives you deliverance but not freedom and you can be independent and still be in bondage to a a 30 40 60 100 year old conditioning that you haven't changed and it's hard to change your mind say with me it's hard to change my mind say it loud it's hard to change my mind say it again it's hard to change your mind and the bible teaches clearly as a man think it so is he not as a man believe it that's why even though you may believe in jesus it doesn't mean you think freedom and so in order for egypt to lose its hold on us we need to be re-conditioned paul says we need to have our minds renewed and so bondage brings laziness hatred for work slavery brings lack of creativity and most of all irresponsibility and i tell you what one of the most dangerous things that oppression brings is low self-esteem if i have ever seen bondage it's in this area i've seen great people with great gifts who hate themselves i've seen people with great anointing who hate themselves i've seen people with great talent and great abilities who hate themselves i went to a christian university a great university and then university taught us a lot of academics it even taught us a lot of physical discipline it also taught us a lot of spiritual information but do you know that as a person coming from a third world country with an oppressed mind that university did not teach me how to be free curriculums or curriculi you got to be careful with them because i looked at the rebecca curriculum and i appreciate the attack we got christian schools here in our country my children go to one of them and they have their backup curriculum and as i study their back curriculum i got a degree in education matter of fact one of my major areas of studies was child psychology and when i learned how children learn and how they develop curriculum to teach children i discovered that most of the curriculum that we even in the formerly oppressed areas i said are very guardedly because most of us still are but where oppressed people are one of the problems is that we adopt the educational system of the oppressor and remember that curriculum is designed by the one who wrote it and the curriculum is designed for the one who wrote it please write that down don't forget that when a person gives you a curriculum it was written for their children not for you and so if you just adapt it and adopt it then you may be missing some crucial problems that you may have that was not addressed for example if the person who wrote the curriculum never had your experience or never went through what you went through then the curriculum is not designed to set you free from what put you in bondage so i discovered that the oppressed mind has some very unique problems for example the poor self-concept we're still in bondage even though you are delivered you're still not free from the image that was painted in your mind by the oppressor so deliverance doesn't mean you're free from what they thought about you or what they told you to think about yourself and then when you read their book their book looks like them and they were what you saw for 300 years so when you see this thing it looks like them and it speaks for them then you end up still being in bondage to what you saw for 300 years i'm trying to get you to understand something freedom demands a mental transformation paul says you are not transformed until you are renewed in your mind i am not convinced that being saved means you're free i am sure being saved means you go to heaven but you will have hell on earth because if you don't be set free renewed in your minds then you will be a candidate for heaven but you'll not be fit to live free on earth
